title: seek horikita cooperation through kiyotaka
context: Year 1 Volume 4 cruise Zodiac special exam and immediate shipboard relationships; actor information is restricted to direct accessible episodes.
observed_actions: Asks Kiyotaka to act as intermediary with Suzune, then revises approach after hearing how indirect manipulation can backfire.
observed_result: Admits the plan is short-sighted and considers direct contact.
epistemic_limits: The request did not itself persuade Suzune; that outcome is not credited to Hirata here.
information_available: Only direct in-story actor knowledge available at this scene; later VIP disclosures and trauma accounts do not become globally accessible memories.
counterfactual_test: If trust, actor health, isolation, incentives or available evidence differ, the observed event/outcome need not recur; violence and sexual coercion are not normative protocols.
